same_information: Give eligible methods the same public initial task, roles, permitted workflow, policies and observable execution prefix.

Fit on training groups; select prompts, hyperparameters and thresholds on development/calibration groups only; freeze before untouched confirmation evaluation.
comparison_contract.normal_workflows: Report false-alarm rate on independently verified nonviolating workflows; attack attempts are not automatically harmful and control cases are not automatically safe.
comparison_contract.topk_methods: Report author top-k malicious-node results in their native setting. For unknown attack count or all-normal workflows, additionally predeclare a validation-calibrated score threshold and report this adaptation separately.
comparison_contract.mandatory_exact_rule_control: Current policy detection must include the independent policy interpreter on the same fully bound facts. Agreement is expected when facts are complete; this is not a future-behavior predictor.
